SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Confirm whether your proposed fishing is on the lake, a nearby tributary or both. Accommodation alone is not a complete guided package; get the boat, method and supplied-equipment details before completing the checklist.

Choose the access before the outfit

Lake fishing can mean a bank session, trolling, jigging or a guided casting day. Confirm which of those is actually offered. Check boat and equipment provision before buying a second setup, and keep the personal day bag distinct from shared tackle.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for New Zealand — Fish & Game

Everyone who fishes for sports fish needs a licence, including children and visitors. Overseas visitors need a non-resident licence; Fish & Game licences do not cover Taupo.

  • 24 hours$39 NZD
  • 1 October–30 September$273 NZD
  • 24 hours$24 NZD
  • 1 October–30 September$52 NZD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Lake Brunner is open all year to fly, spin and bait fishing.
  • Daily limits are two brown trout and two rainbow trout; no minimum trout length applies.
  • Use one assembled rod; felt-soled footwear is prohibited.
  • Check Lake Brunner and any tributary separately in the official regulations official regulations ↗
